description: Fix the Next.js 16.x blocking prerender error on /sign-in caused by `await connection()` and `await auth()` being called outside Suspense in a static page. Also verify SignInForm.tsx does not expose credentials in the URL. These two issues are independent of all other FEATs — no schema or API changes needed.
steps: Read src/app/sign-in/page.tsx. Remove the two top-of-file imports for `connection` and `auth`. Remove the `await connection()` call and the `await auth()` + `redirect('/admin')` block entirely. The middleware (src/middleware.ts or proxy.ts) already protects /admin and redirects logged-in users away from /sign-in — the server-side session check in the page is redundant. Keep the static HTML scaffold, the JSX icon, the h1/p header, the card wrapper, and the `<Suspense fallback={null}><SignInForm /></Suspense>` render unchanged. The page becomes a pure static server component with no dynamic data access, which is correct for a login page.

Read src/app/sign-in/SignInForm.tsx. Confirm: (a) The form calls `signIn('credentials', { email, password, redirect: false })` from 'next-auth/react' — credentials go in the JSON body of the NextAuth POST, never in the URL. (b) No `router.push` includes email/password query params. (c) The form uses `method` default (POST) — not GET. (d) The `callbackUrl` is read from `searchParams.get('callbackUrl')` (URL param for the redirect destination, not credentials). If all of these are already correct — they are, based on reading — make no changes. If any issue is found, fix it.
Run `npm run typecheck` and fix any TypeScript errors introduced. Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 — the /sign-in route must no longer show the blocking prerender warning.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` exits 0 with no prerender warning for /sign-in route
src/app/sign-in/page.tsx contains no import or call to `connection` or `auth`
src/app/sign-in/SignInForm.tsx passes credentials only via POST body (signIn API call), never via URL params
findings: Removed `connection`, `auth`, and `redirect` imports from page.tsx. Removed the `await connection()` call and `await auth()` + `redirect('/admin')` block. Page function changed from async to sync. The page now builds as ○ (Static) with no prerender warning. SignInForm.tsx was already correct: credentials passed only via signIn('credentials', {...}) POST body, callbackUrl is a redirect-destination param (not credentials), no URL exposure. Both `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` exit 0.
